categories: SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE, READ WRITE

SELECT n1.id, e1.id, n1.props FROM (SELECT ? AS id, 1 AS ord) AS f0 LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ((e1.src = f0.id AND (e1.dst_type IS NULL OR (e1.dst_type = ? OR e1.dst_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = ?)))) OR (e1.undirected AND (e1.dst = f0.id AND (e1.src_type IS NULL OR (e1.src_type = ? OR e1.src_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = ?)))))) JOIN anchors n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND n1.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND (n1.arch_type = ? OR n1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = ?)) ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id

INSERT INTO anchors(id,kind,arch_type,arch_module,fingerprint,root_id,src,dst,undirected,props,src_type,dst_type,seq) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?),(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE kind=VALUES(kind),arch_type=VALUES(arch_type),arch_module=VALUES(arch_module),fingerprint=VALUES(fingerprint),root_id=VALUES(root_id),src=VALUES(src),dst=VALUES(dst),undirected=VALUES(undirected),props=VALUES(props),src_type=COALESCE(VALUES(src_type),src_type),dst_type=COALESCE(VALUES(dst_type),dst_type)
